scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml packages/ui/node_modules packages/docs/node_modules packages/app-extension/node_modules packages/app-extension/dist packages/docs/.quasar packages/docs/dist
scripts.build: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:app-ext && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.ci:publish: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qiconpicker publish --access public --publish-branch main && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qiconpicker publish --access public --publish-branch main
scripts.ci:publish:latest: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qiconpicker publish --access public --publish-branch main --tag latest && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qiconpicker publish --access public --publish-branch main --tag latest
scripts.ci:publish:beta: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qiconpicker publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qiconpicker publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
